changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE wf_test.workflow_event_outbox ( id BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, event_id VARCHAR(40) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2 NOT NULL, instance_id BIGINT NOT NULL, history_sequence BIGINT NOT NULL, command_id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, event_type VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL, occurred_at DATETIME2(7) NOT NULL, event_json NVARCHAR(MAX) NOT NULL, delivery_count BIGINT NOT NULL, delivered_at DATETIME2(7) NULL, CONSTRAINT uq_console_outbox_event UNIQUE(event_id), CONSTRAINT uq_console_outbox_sequence UNIQUE(instance_id,history_sequence), CONSTRAINT ck_console_outbox_positive CHECK(instance_id>0 AND history_sequence>0 AND delivery_count>=0), CONSTRAINT ck_console_outbox_delivery CHECK((delivered_at IS NULL AND delivery_count=0) OR (delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND delivery_count>=1)), CONSTRAINT ck_console_outbox_json CHECK(ISJSON(event_json)=1 AND DATALENGTH(event_json)<=262144) ); CREATE INDEX ix_console_outbox_pending ON wf_test.workflow_event_outbox(delivered_at,id);

changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE wf_test.workflow_event_inbox ( id BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, event_id VARCHAR(40) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2 NOT NULL, received_at DATETIME2(7) NOT NULL, event_json NVARCHAR(MAX) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT uq_console_inbox_event UNIQUE(event_id), CONSTRAINT ck_console_inbox_json CHECK(ISJSON(event_json)=1 AND DATALENGTH(event_json)<=262144) );
